name: The Hold of the Gideon Barge
note: W1-04: this is the FIRST cell the player stands in, and until now it did not exist. `jeeh-ei` in game/data/npcs/writ-house.json has declared `interior: barge-hold` and a 00:00-24:00 schedule at `barge-hold` since the opening was written, and the id resolved to nothing — so the one NPC who speaks before the player has a name, a race or a sheet was scheduled into a cell the world could not name. The barge is moored at the Tidewrack quay; the door out of the hold is the door into the writ house queue, which is why `exterior_spawn` here and `writ-house`'s `exterior_door` are eight metres apart on the same quay.

light.note: One open deck hatch astern, and nothing else. The hold is dark enough that the first thing the player does is walk toward light — which is also the way out.

contents.note: Her eggs, and she is too sick to stop you. RI-STL02: the first thing in the game you can steal belongs to the only person who has been kind to you.
Up the ladder, through the hatch, onto the quay and into the writ house queue.

unique_item.name: a hatch-name scratched into the hull rib, in a hand that is not yours

declared_incomplete.owner: wave-1 piece W1-03 (interior art) for the furnishing pass; W1-07 owns the creation scene that follows this cell
